column7: Yomitan's suffixInflection('', 'x') turns every text into x because slice(0, -0) is empty; not ported.
The umlaut rule returns an empty text when the stem has no ä; the pack's stemChange does not apply then.
Yomitan matches a particle as a prefix of the next word; the pack matches whole words.
The pack has no such processor.
Yomitan builds its per-transform heuristic from the sources without the i flag, so only ER reaches the rule; the pack matches every case.
The engine never returns an empty text; Yomitan does when a rule consumes the whole text.
